title: Tail Competition Explains Scaling in Best-of-N Sampling for Verifiable Problems
abstract: arXiv:2610.19362v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Best-of-N sampling is a simple inference-time scaling strategy for large language models, yet its behavior under incomplete reward models remains poorly understood. We study Best-of-N as a competition between the extreme reward tails of correct and incorrect responses. This view shows that success depends not only on the probability of sampling a correct response, but also on whether correct responses dominate incorrect ones in the upper tail. Using extreme value theory, we characterize three asymptotic regimes: correct-tail-dominant, incorrect-tail-dominant, and critical explaining both monotonic gains and reward-hacking-induced degradation. We further derive finite-sample scaling laws for representative reward distributions, showing that, under Gaussian rewards, incorrect responses with sufficiently large variance can dominate selection even when their mean reward is lower. translated_title: 尾部竞争解释了可验证问题中 Best-of-N 采样的缩放规律
translated_abstract: Best-of-N 采样是大语言模型一种简单的推理时扩展策略，然而其在不完整奖励模型下的行为仍鲜为人知。我们将 Best-of-N 研究为正确响应与错误响应的极端奖励尾部之间的竞争。这一视角表明，成功不仅取决于采样到正确响应的概率，还取决于正确响应是否在上尾部中占优于错误响应。利用极值理论，我们刻画了三种渐近状态：正确尾部主导、错误尾部主导和临界状态，从而同时解释了单调增益和奖励作弊导致的性能退化。我们进一步针对代表性奖励分布推导了有限样本缩放定律，表明在高斯奖励下，方差足够大的错误响应即使平均奖励更低，也可能在选择过程中占据主导。与理想选择不同，使用不完整选择器时的收敛（原文摘要在此截断）
tldr: 该论文将 Best-of-N 采样建模为正确与错误响应极端奖励尾部之间的竞争，利用极值理论刻画出正确尾部主导、错误尾部主导和临界三种渐近状态，统一解释了缩放增益与奖励作弊导致的性能退化，并推导了有限样本缩放定律。
en_tdlr: This paper models Best-of-N sampling as a competition between the extreme reward tails of correct and incorrect responses, uses extreme value theory to characterize three asymptotic regimes that explain both scaling gains and reward-hacking-induced degradation, and derives finite-sample scaling laws.
